items.prompt: Why can an iid bootstrap of ten observed losses miss an unobserved crash tail?

options.text: It always generates all possible future events
Resampling proves that returns are independent
options.why: The sampling assumption is not established by using a function.

options.text: More repeats eliminate all model uncertainty
options.why: Simulation precision does not repair a missing population tail.

options.text: Its empirical source distribution lacks that unseen event
options.why: Dependence and source-model limits remain even with many repetitions.

items.explanation: Resampling can study uncertainty under an empirical model; it cannot by itself supply unseen support or fix dependence.
